categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Touches shared unit test helper utilities in src/test/util/mining.cpp and src/test/util/mining.h.
categories.rationale: Fixes edge-case bugs in test mining utilities where 'a fork crossing a halving can overpay and fail with bad-cb-amount' and low height scripts fail BIP 34 length requirements. This improves test framework reliability for reorg and fork testing, though reviewers note that building such chains in unit tests is relatively rare.
